info.description: ElevenLabs sound effects model that generates sound effects from text prompts. Compared with eleven_text_to_sound_v2, it follows several sound instructions in one prompt more closely, handles prompts with music or vocals, sounds more natural, and is less likely to clip on high-frequency sounds; it supports looping. It uses the same Sound Effects API, where eleven_text_to_sound_v2 remains the default model_id. It is in limited access and may not be available in every region; accounts without access get an Unknown model error. The stored price is the Sound Effects API rate of $0.12 per minute.

zh.description: ElevenLabs 音效模型，根据文本提示生成音效。与 eleven_text_to_sound_v2 相比，它能更准确地执行同一提示中的多条声音指令，能处理包含音乐或人声的提示，声音更自然，高频声音更不容易削波，并支持循环。它使用同一个 Sound Effects API，默认 model_id 仍是 eleven_text_to_sound_v2。目前为受限访问，并非所有地区都可用；没有权限的账户会收到 Unknown model 错误。记录的价格是 Sound Effects API 的每分钟 $0.12。
